name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; [ -f api/requirements.txt ] && python3 -m venv api/.venv && api/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && api/.venv/bin/pip install -r api/requirements-dev.txt; [ -f web/package.json ] && (cd web && npm install); echo 'Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: streamlit run src/"Alignment Visualizer.py" --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
